about: Public-notice channels per operator or agency: pages, sites, feeds, lists and accounts through which the public is told of sewage discharges, by law, permit or voluntarily. Read by pipeline/ingest/notification_pages.py (schema and validator there; test tests/test_notice_channels.py).

channels.legal_basis: IDEM's sewer bypass/overflow reporting instructions (the NPDES permit's standard conditions; 40 CFR 122.41(l)(6)): an overflow, bypass or sewage basement backup is reported to IDEM within 24 hours on State Form 48373

channels.name: CWA Authority, Inc. (Citizens Energy Group), Indianapolis
channels.legal_basis: 327 IAC 5-2.1-5(d): "Notification must be provided whenever information from a reliable source indicates that: (1) a discharge or discharges from one (1) or more combined sewer overflow outfalls is occurring; or (2) a discharge ... is imminent based on predicted or actual precipitation or a related event"; 327 IAC 5-2.1-6: notice to those who ask after the March newspaper notice "in a manner that is mutually agreeable to the recipient and the CSO community", and signs at public access points
channels.note: E-mail CSO warnings when about a quarter inch of rain or more is forecast (Citizens' 2018 post, which now redirects to the company's home page); the sign-up route not found in this pass.
